'''2006 Wisconsin State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Saturday 10 June 2006 at Misty Mountain Games & Diversions, 1922 S. Stoughton Rd., Madison, Wisconsin, with a tournament director who posted as Spencer_00_us.<ref name="sf-10070-138643">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=138643#p138643 Official WI State Championship Post], Spencer_00_us, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (26 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126023437/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10070 Internet Archive]</ref> [[Jim Li]] won; after a dispute over whether he could pass the [[2006 World Championship|World Championship]] bye to the second-place player, [[Michael Carr|Mike Carr]] ruled that Li was the Wisconsin State Champion and received both the Day 2 bye and the virtual card design.<ref name="sf-10070-143141">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=143141#p143141 Official WI State Championship Post], mc9457 (Mike Carr), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125165404/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10070-start100.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Misty Mountain Games & Diversions, 1922 S. Stoughton Rd., Madison, Wisconsin<ref name="sf-10070-138643" />
* '''Dates:''' 10 June 2006<ref name="sf-10070-138643" />
* '''Time:''' 12:00 pm Central<ref name="sf-10070-138643" />
* '''Format:''' six games and a final confrontation between the top two players<ref name="sf-10070-139222">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=139222#p139222 Official WI State Championship Post], Schele, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (31 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126023437/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10070 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-10070-139292">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=139292#p139292 Official WI State Championship Post], Spencer_00_us, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (1 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126023437/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10070 Internet Archive]</ref>; decklists to be ready before the event<ref name="sf-10070-138643" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="sf-10070-138643" />
* '''Tournament director:''' Spencer_00_us ("Spencer")<ref name="sf-10070-138643" /><ref name="sf-10070-142423">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=142423#p142423 Official WI State Championship Post], Spencer_00_us, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125165619/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10070-start20.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Winner:''' [[Jim Li]]<ref name="sf-10070-143141" />

== Organization ==

Spencer posted the official thread on 26 May 2006. Prizes were the Players Committee's Ultimate Prize Package plus six singles from his own collection, to be given out at random to the players finishing second to seventh. Questions about the venue went to [[Evan Fitzgerald]].<ref name="sf-10070-138643" /> Asked whether the event would be six games and a top-two final confrontation, Spencer confirmed it.<ref name="sf-10070-139222" /><ref name="sf-10070-139292" /> The day before the event he added a special prize for the deck voted "Most Creative Out of This World Deck".<ref name="sf-10070-140374">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=140374#p140374 Official WI State Championship Post], Spencer_00_us, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (9 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126023437/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10070 Internet Archive]</ref> After the event he thanked "Evan for lending a helping hand".<ref name="sf-10070-141246">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=141246#p141246 Official WI State Championship Post], Spencer_00_us, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (15 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125165619/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10070-start20.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Results ==

Crazy Hermit, who was ill and did not attend, reported what other players had told him: Jim Li went undefeated with TRM and a walker objective, and [[Jim Beyer]] was second as the highest 4–2 player, with Endor mains and HD dueling.<ref name="sf-10070-140535">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=140535#p140535 Official WI State Championship Post], Crazy Hermit, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (11 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126023437/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10070 Internet Archive]</ref> Evan Fitzgerald wrote that [[Brandon Schele]] went 3–3 while feeling unwell.<ref name="sf-10070-140611">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=140611#p140611 Official WI State Championship Post], PapaLorax (Evan Fitzgerald), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126023437/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10070 Internet Archive]</ref> Li thanked [[Alden Peterson]] for lending him two ready-made decks.<ref name="sf-10070-140687">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=140687#p140687 Official WI State Championship Post], jimli (Jim Li), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126023437/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10070 Internet Archive]</ref>

The full standings were not posted in the topic, so Schele's place is not known.

== Bye dispute ==

No final confrontation was played. Li and Beyer skipped it on the understanding that Li would take the virtual card design and Beyer the bye to Worlds.<ref name="sf-10070-140709">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=140709#p140709 Official WI State Championship Post], jimli (Jim Li), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125165619/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10070-start20.html Internet Archive]</ref> Li, who was not going to Worlds, asked that his bye be passed to the second-place finisher.<ref name="sf-10070-140704">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=140704#p140704 Official WI State Championship Post], jimli (Jim Li), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125165619/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10070-start20.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Nick Kolnik]] replied that the Players Committee's policy on byes did not allow voluntary passing, and Li offered to concede the final confrontation instead.<ref name="sf-10070-140708">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=140708#p140708 Official WI State Championship Post], bluethrawn (Nick Kolnik), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125165619/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10070-start20.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-10070-140709" />

On 21 June 2006 Spencer posted the final result: Li would receive the bye and the virtual card design, because the application stated that "Byes may not be voluntarily passed". He wrote that the next year's event would start earlier so that the final confrontation could be played.<ref name="sf-10070-142423" /> On 23 June 2006 Carr closed the discussion: Li was Wisconsin State Champion, winner of the Day 2 bye and virtual card designer. Carr explained that a Day 2 bye passes down only when the first-place player already holds one, and that a virtual card design does not pass.<ref name="sf-10070-143141" />
